The TP2 PP1 layout with a decode batch size of 64 achieves 135.2 tokens/s per user, meeting the >=100 tokens/s interactivity constraint while maximizing output throughput per device at 2215.0 tokens/s.
NVIDIA B200 in FP8 precision with TP1, PP1, and a decode batch size of 32 maximizes output tokens/s per device at 7059.0 while satisfying the interactivity constraint with 338.0 tokens/s per user.

At FP8 precision with TP=4, PP=1, and a decode batch size of 128, the layout achieves the maximum throughput of 530.1 output tokens/s per device while maintaining an interactivity of 59.4 tokens/s per user (above the 50 tokens/s threshold).
NVIDIA B200 with TP8, PP1, and decode batch size 32 achieves 140.1 tokens/s per user, satisfying the 120 tokens/s SLA while maximizing output throughput at 313.5 tokens/s per device.

The TP8 PP1 layout with expert parallelism enabled at decode batch size 256 maximizes output tokens/s per device (1114.0) while satisfying the interactivity SLA of at least 80 tokens/s per user (90.66 tokens/s).
TP=8 PP=1 with decode batch size 32 maximizes output tokens/s per device (65.22) while satisfying the interactivity constraint of at least 30 tokens/s per user (34.99 tokens/s).
